rights_note: The NYPL-attributed Wikimedia Commons item gives publication date 1856, Public domain, Copyrighted=False, and PD-scan / PD-old-auto-expired. The separately marketed Granger reproduction is not the source used here.
access_notes: Reviewed 2026-11-03: retrieved the current Commons item metadata and its NYPL-credited 3046 × 2180 scan, and read the lithographer/publisher imprints and LAKE HOUSE sign in that image. The direct NYPL item URL returned an automated-access placeholder, so its live catalog page was not independently read. note: LATER COMPLETED STATE ONLY. Despite the local filename ending in 1830, the lighthouse, completed Lake House and steamboat belong to a later scene, approximately 1836–1849. The labelled hotel is right of the foreground fort blockhouse, partly behind a tree, with regular window rows and a central cupola. This retrospective print cannot establish the roof, height, extent or progress of the unfinished Lake House on 1 July 1835. No fitted camera or accepted geometric match is supplied.
what_it_supplies: A credited public-domain contextual image of the later completed Lake House and river mouth.
A visual cross-check of the completed hotel, subject to retrospective illustration and foreground occlusion.
what_it_does_not_supply: The construction stage, height or roof of the hotel on 1 July 1835.
Metric dimensions, exact world placement, hidden elevations or an accepted camera fit.
Permission at this tier to trace geometry or to replace the July 1835 construction shell with the completed hotel.
